scope: Read-only inspection of the locally installed official Kaggle CLI and its bundled generated kernel SDK. No authenticated API request, kernel status query, artifact listing/download, source pull, kernel edit, or launch occurred in this check.

generated_kernel_service.method_surface_observation: The installed generated service exposes latest-session status, latest-session output listing, and output-download calls (including a ZIP call addressed by kernel_session_id). It exposes no method to enumerate kernel sessions or retrieve session history/IDs.

broader_sdk_sweep.scope: Enumerated every generated non-transport service client under the installed kagglesdk */services/*.py modules and scanned the complete installed Python package for session/history/run-list terms.
broader_sdk_sweep.finding: Only KernelsApiClient contains kernel-run/session methods. The only session-ID-like fields outside Kernels are an Education fork-parent reference and a Users account kernel_session_id field; the latter's client exposes only generate_access_token. Neither is a session-history/list operation. Other session matches are HTTP-client transport state.

interpretation.verified: This exact installed official SDK surface provides no session-history/list method for binding current outputs to a historical run/version; all ten generated non-transport service clients were inventoried and no such method exists outside the Kernels service.
